named_events.loss_description: The Syndicate's ultimate loss estimate at 31 December 2020 is GBP 71.6m gross and GBP 21.7m net of reinsurance and including reinstatement premiums, primarily in its Accident and Health, Personal Accident Treaty and Credit Risk lines of business.

On 13 February 2021, the Winter Storm Uri loss event commenced in the US State of Texas. At the date of these financial statements, it is too early to quantify the effects, however, it is an event which is in the normal course of insurance business and the Syndicate will closely monitor developments in the coming weeks. Any losses relating to this event will be recognised in the 2021 calendar year financial statements.
